title: Principal Oracle Health Data Migration Architect
jobDescription:
Principal Oracle Health Data Migration Architect Principal Oracle Health Data Migration Architect Job Description Principal Oracle Health Data Migration Architect Job Description We are seeking experienced Principal Data Migration Architect to lead the strategy, design, governance, and execution of complex healthcare data migration initiatives supporting Oracle Health Millennium implementations and modernization programs. The role is responsible for overseeing migration architecture, technical delivery, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and data quality activities to ensure successful migration of clinical, financial, and operational data into Oracle Health solutions. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Lead the design, planning, and execution of large-scale Oracle Health data migration projects. Define migration strategies, scope, requirements, timelines, deliverables, and implementation approaches aligned to business and technical objectives. Develop and oversee migration plans covering data extraction, transformation, mapping, normalization, validation, reconciliation, and loading activities. Lead migration solution architecture and large-scale data conversion efforts across multiple workstreams. Serve as the primary migration lead and trusted advisor for clients, project leadership, and technical teams. Provide technical leadership and oversight during migration testing, validation, cutover, go-live, and post-implementation activities. Act as the final escalation point for complex migration, data quality, and conversion-related issues. Identify migration risks, dependencies, and challenges, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful project outcomes. Coordinate resources, priorities, and project activities while ensuring adherence to schedules, budgets, and quality standards. Establish migration governance, standards, methodologies, and best practices across delivery teams. Drive continuous improvement initiatives for migration tools, automation, processes, and delivery frameworks. Ensure compliance with data governance, security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements. Required Qualifications Experience 6 to 10+ years of experience leading large-scale data migration, data conversion, healthcare implementation, or transformation projects. Experience managing complex migration programs involving multiple stakeholders, technical teams, and client organizations. Experience working with healthcare systems, EHR/EMR platforms, and healthcare data models. Proven experience leading migration strategy, architecture, governance, and delivery activities. Technical Skills Strong expertise in ETL processes, data extraction, transformation, loading, mapping, normalization, reconciliation, and validation methodologies. Advanced SQL and database knowledge. Experience with data migration tools, conversion frameworks, and automation solutions. Knowledge of Oracle databases, cloud technologies, and enterprise data migration practices. Strong understanding of data quality management, governance, and migration testing methodologies. Healthcare & Integration Knowledge Understanding of healthcare data structures, clinical workflows, and healthcare information systems. Knowledge of EHR/EMR platforms and healthcare data conversion practices. Familiarity with healthcare interoperability concepts and healthcare data exchange standards. Professional Skills Strong project leadership, consulting, stakeholder management, and client engagement skills. Advanced analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and documentation skills. Ability to operate independently while managing multiple complex workstreams and priorities. Preferred Qualifications Oracle Health Millennium migration experience. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) experience. Healthcare Saa S migration experience. ITIL certification. Citrix certification. Cloud certification (OCI, Azure, or AWS). Experience supporting acute care, ambulatory, and revenue cycle environments. Experience with Oracle Health Millennium/Cerner solutions. Experience leading enterprise-scale healthcare implementations and geographically distributed teams. Project Management, Healthcare IT, Data Management, or related professional certifications. Preferred Millennium Domain Experience Power Chart, First Net, Surgi Net, Pharmacy, Path Net, Rad Net, Revenue Cycle, Scheduling, MPages, Discern Rules, Discern Explorer (CCL), Healthe Intent, Interoperability Platforms. Qualifications Career Level

title: Technical Oracle Health (Millennium) Project Manager
jobDescription:
Oracle Customer Success Services is a One Oracle approach to ensuring customer success through a broad set of services and solutions delivered by certified and experienced implementers. The organization helps accelerate the customer journey by providing customer-centric delivery and support-integrated services in close collaboration with Oracle Development. This role works closely with technical teams, subject matter experts, client stakeholders, governance leaders, and healthcare operations teams to ensure projects are delivered with clarity, accountability, and measurable business impact. Oracle Customer Success Services is a One Oracle approach to ensuring customer success through a broad set of services and solutions delivered by certified and experienced implementers. The organization helps accelerate the customer journey by providing customer-centric delivery and support-integrated services in close collaboration with Oracle Development. This role works closely with technical teams, subject matter experts, client stakeholders, governance leaders, and healthcare operations teams to ensure projects are delivered with clarity, accountability, and measurable business impact. Job Description We are seeking an experienced Technical Oracle Health Project Manager to lead and coordinate Oracle Health Millennium projects focused on technical delivery, issue resolution, operational improvements, and client outcomes. The role is responsible for managing project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams, tracking risks and dependencies, supporting governance processes, and ensuring successful delivery of project objectives within scope, schedule, and budget. This is a contract role suited for a hands-on project manager with strong healthcare IT experience and working knowledge of Oracle Health Millennium environments. Responsibilities
- Key Responsibilities Develop, manage, and execute project plans aligned to project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, and objectives. Coordinate cross-functional teams, technical resources, subject matter experts, client stakeholders, and business workstreams to drive successful project execution. Track milestones, deliverables, dependencies, action items, issues, risks, and changes throughout the project lifecycle. Provide regular project status reporting, including executive-level updates, dashboards, risk logs, mitigation plans, and decision points. Facilitate project meetings, technical working sessions, stakeholder updates, governance reviews, and escalation discussions. Drive accountability across project teams to ensure timely completion of deliverables, commitments, and project actions. Develop and maintain project documentation, presentations, reports, Share Point artifacts, meeting notes, and project governance materials. Support identification, escalation, and resolution of complex technical, operational, and client-impacting issues. Ensure adherence to project governance standards, operational processes, security requirements, and organizational policies. Support Oracle Health implementation, migration, optimization, and transformation initiatives across clinical, technical, and operational environments.
4. Qualifications & Skills Mandatory 5+ years of project management experience in healthcare IT, consulting, technical delivery, healthcare operations, or related environments. Proven experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, technical teams, business teams, and cross-functional workstreams. Experience managing project schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and executive-level reporting. Strong understanding of Oracle Health Millennium architecture, workflows, implementation processes, or operational environments. Experience working within healthcare technology, clinical systems, healthcare operations, or large-scale healthcare transformation programs. Strong project planning, execution, governance, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Experience with risk management, issue management, dependency tracking, change management, and escalation management. Proficiency with Share Point administration, document management, Microsoft Power Point, project reporting, dashboards, and executive presentations. Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams in fast-paced, complex, and highly regulated environments. Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Good-to-Have Oracle Health Millennium migration experience. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Healthcare Saa S migration experience. Experience supporting acute care, ambulatory, revenue cycle, or clinical operations environments. Familiarity with Oracle Health/Cerner solutions and implementation methodologies. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, ITIL, Citrix, OCI, Azure, or AWS certifications. Experience with Oracle Health Millennium domains such as Power Chart, First Net, Surgi Net, Pharmacy, Path Net, Rad Net, Revenue Cycle, Scheduling, MPages, Discern Rules, Discern Explorer/CCL, Healthe Intent, or interoperability platforms.
5. Self-Assessment Questions Candidates may reflect on the following questions to evaluate their fit for this

ROLE:
Have I managed complex healthcare IT or technical delivery projects involving multiple stakeholders, technical teams, risks, dependencies, and executive-level reporting? Do I have hands-on experience or a strong working understanding of Oracle Health Millennium architecture, workflows, implementation, migration, or operational environments? Can I independently develop and maintain project plans, governance materials, dashboards, Share Point documentation, status reports, and executive presentations? Am I comfortable driving accountability across cross-functional teams while managing competing priorities, escalations, and project risks in a fast-paced environment? Have I worked in regulated healthcare technology environments where compliance, security, operational processes, and client outcomes are critical to project success? Qualifications
